text: Could you make a realistic video of a golden retriever catching a red frisbee in a grassy park? I’ve always had a soft spot for golden retrievers, so this seemed like a fun thing to ask for. What I have in mind is 5 seconds long and widescreen, with everything happening in one continuous shot. I’m probably over-explaining because I don’t often know how to describe video ideas. Please keep the camera staying still throughout, and have no sound.
